description: This Python source file defines a CustomLogger class used for logging events, including pre- and post-API call events, handling of streaming responses, and redaction of sensitive data such as base64-encoded files. It also includes methods for managing callback environment variables, error handling, and data redaction, with support for asynchronous operations and integration with external systems like Promptlayer and Argilla.
